author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Does your resume say you know Excel… but you’ve never actually used it? Let’s fix that.

In this video, I’ll walk you through Excel from scratch, step by step. You’ll learn the core basics you actually need to get started, including how to enter data, format your spreadsheet, use tables, create charts, and even use formulas and functions.

We’ll build a real example together using a simple sales tracker, so you can follow along and immediately apply what you learn.

You’ll also see how Excel’s built-in AI (Copilot) can help analyze your data, generate insights, and save you time.

By the end of this video, you’ll have a solid foundation and the confidence to start using Excel on your own.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
